user.title: Recall
user.description: Recall remembers states with `recall.save` and puts them back with `recall.restore` – unless someone changed the device by hand in the meantime. No settings needed.

saver_installed.title: Saver is still installed
saver_installed.description: Recall replaces the Saver integration. Once all automations use `recall.save` / `recall.restore` instead of `saver.save_state` / `saver.restore_state`, delete the Saver integration and remove it from HACS. This notice disappears by itself.

nothing_saved.message: Nothing remembered: {entity_id} does not exist or is unavailable.

forget_nothing.message: Choose a slot, entities or both to forget.

save.name: Remember state
save.description: Remembers the current state of entities in a slot so it can be restored later.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Name of the memory slot. Use different slots for different automations so they do not overwrite each other.

expires_after.name: Expires after
expires_after.description: Forget the remembered state automatically after this time. Empty = integration setting, 0 = never.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace a state already remembered in this slot. Off keeps the first (original) state.

tolerance.name: Tolerance
tolerance.description: How far position, tilt, brightness, fan speed or volume may drift (percentage points) before it counts as changed by hand. Empty = integration setting.

restore.name: Restore state
restore.description: Restores the remembered state. Skips entities someone changed by hand since then.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Restore only these entities. Empty = everything remembered in the slot. In YAML, `target` with areas, devices or labels works too.

only_if_unchanged.name: Only if unchanged
only_if_unchanged.description: Skip entities that were changed by hand or by another automation after the automation moved them. Empty = integration setting.

forget.name: Forget afterwards
forget.description: Remove the remembered state after restoring (also when skipped because it was changed by hand). Empty = integration setting.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Fade time for lights in seconds.

forget.name: Forget state
forget.description: Removes remembered states without restoring them. Without a slot all slots are affected, without entities the whole slot.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Forget only these entities. Empty = the whole slot. In YAML, `target` with areas, devices or labels works too.

is_saved.name: State is remembered
is_saved.description: Tests if all target entities have a remembered state in a slot.

unchanged.name: Only if unchanged
unchanged.description: Also require that nobody changed the entities by hand since the automation moved them.

settings.title: Default settings
settings.description: These values apply whenever an automation does not set the field itself in `recall.save` or `recall.restore`. Changes take effect right away, no restart needed.

restore.name: Restoring
restore.description: What happens when a remembered state is restored.

data_description.only_if_unchanged: On: if someone changed the device after the automation (by hand, in the app or by another automation), it stays as it is. Off: always put it back.
data_description.forget: On: the remembered state is used once and then deleted. Off: it stays remembered and can be restored again.

detection.name: Detecting manual changes
detection.description: Fine-tuning; the defaults suit most blinds and lights.

data_description.tolerance: How much position, tilt, brightness, fan speed or volume may differ without counting as a manual change (e.g. a blind ending at 41 % instead of 40 %).
data_description.settle_quiet: After the automation moves a device, it must stay still this long. That end position is what the automation wanted.
data_description.settle_wait: If the device does not change at all after remembering, this is how long Recall waits before taking the current state as wanted.
data_description.settle_max: Devices that never come to rest are fixed after this time at the latest.

expiry.name: Expiry
expiry.description: Remembered states that are never restored (e.g. after a power cut) are forgotten automatically.

data_description.expires_after: Empty or 0 = never forget automatically. An automation can set its own value with “expires after”.

saved.title: Remembered states

data_description.slots: The selected slots are deleted without restoring.
